Following `/app/docs/CONVENTIONS.md`, I also did these things:
- **Change note:** I added `/app/changes/CART-58.md`, whose first line is `ticket: CART-58`.
- **Commit:** I committed with the message `[CART-58] fix price`. I did not push.
- **Verification:** `bash scripts/verify.sh` exited 0, so both price checks (500 → 450 and 1000 → 900) pass. I made no edits after running it.
- **Issue label:** I added the `needs-check` label to issue #31. I did not merge or close anything.
